label: Seeker Missile
note: IP-neutral. Fires with or without a lock, in space and in the air: with one (keep the target in the cone for lock_time seconds) it homes; without one it flies straight off the nose like a bolt. A rack of four (mag): holding the key fires them off one every rate seconds, and a lock holds through the salvo (AI pilots only fire locked, and lock afresh for each). reload_each: one seeker comes back every 1.5 s while the rack is short (reload_time is unused then); the air and space share one rack. Where it bursts (a hit, or the ground) it goes up like a vehicle (ExplosionFx.big at blast_size) and hurts everything within splash_radius by splash_damage. 'damage' is a hit on a ship's hull, 'personnel_damage' a hit on anything else (as ship_cannon). In a space fight its speed and ranges (splash_radius too) are scaled (content/core/flow/space_fight.json). In the air it locks on the Remnant interceptor.
